fields.updates: Array of { date, type, title, summary, link }

updates.title: CLASE: Chinese Stylistic Evaluation
updates.summary: A hybrid, reference-free framework combining interpretable linguistic features with experience-guided LLM-as-a-judge scoring, with legal Chinese as the testbed.

updates.title: Co-founded Monticule
updates.summary: Founded Monticule with my partner, seeking to scale continual learning and personal models into diverse real-world applications.

updates.title: Joined the Qwen Team, Alibaba Group
updates.summary: Started as a visiting algorithm engineer, working on foundation models for heritage science.

updates.title: Towards Computational Chinese Paleography
updates.summary: A position paper on what computational Chinese paleography is becoming: the end-to-end methodological pipeline, bottlenecks, and opportunities.

updates.title: Joined PKUDH
updates.summary: Joined the Peking University & ByteDance Digital Humanities Open Lab at the Institute for Artificial Intelligence, working on multi-modal intelligence for cultural heritage.

updates.title: Pun2Pun: Textual-Visual Chinese-English Pun Translation via Linguistic Reasoning
updates.summary: A benchmark for pun translation between Chinese and English, with the Constant-Variable Optimization strategy and the Overlap metric; ACL 2025 SRW.

updates.title: Do Androids Question Electric Sheep? A Multi-Agent Simulation of Philosophical Reflection
updates.summary: LLM agents debate as great thinkers to solve table reasoning, revealing an “overthinking threshold” where more thinking hurts; ACL 2025 SRW.

updates.title: PanelTR: Zero-Shot Table Reasoning Through Multi-Agent Discussion
updates.summary: Five LLM-powered scientist personas investigate, self-review, and debate to answer complex table questions without prior training; IJCNN 2025.

updates.title: Constituent Order Differences in Adverbials, in English and Chinese News
updates.summary: How English and Chinese news organize time, location, and manner information differently within sentences.

updates.title: CLASE: Chinese Stylistic Evaluation
updates.summary: 混合式无参考中文风格评测框架：可解释语言学特征 + 经验引导的 LLM 评分，以法律中文为测试床。

updates.title: Towards Computational Chinese Paleography
